notes.title: Gravethorn Demo – Patch Notes (1.4.3)
notes.notes:
[h2]Audio & Visual Feedback[/h2][list][*][p][b]Soundtrack Update[/b]
The majority of in-game music tracks have been replaced with original compositions. 
[/p][/*][/list][p]Apart from the Chapel tracks, which include Creative Commons songs by [b]pianocafe_Kumi ([/b][url="https://pixabay.com/tr/users/pianocafe_kumi-35185506"]Pixabay Profile[/url]): [i]“Phantom Night”[/i], [i]“Kill Me Baby”[/i], [i]“Werewolf”[/i], and [i]“Ghost”[/i].[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug in the Laél boss fight: if Laél was attacking and the player used the Infernal Woe Forbidden Art, Laél would interrupt/cancel her attack and perform a chaotic sequence of consecutive strikes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed timing issues for parry windows on some bosses. Deathsong attacks now properly stagger them when parried correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the Mad Beast at the start of the game: if the final blow was a Deathsong stagger hit, Execution input was blocked and the boss would revive shortly after.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an additional Mad Beast bug: pressing the Interaction key instantly when the boss’s HP reached 0 could start the Execution animation slightly early, breaking synchronization between the player and the boss.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Gamepad input not registering during the dialogue window for one of the Chapel’s lost cats.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed gold veins visually appearing active when revisiting a region or loading a game, even if they were already depleted.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a camera issue near the Forgotten Sentinel boss area in Murkway: the camera sometimes remained too low, hiding upper platforms.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Chapel Map Tutorial text: previously, if the player didn’t proceed forward or pressed the Map button, the tutorial text remained on screen indefinitely.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Deathsong tutorial text at the game’s start: the font size was rather small.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed confusion in early-game corpse interaction text: “You must carry the Deathspeaker’s Talisman to speak with the spirit” changed to clarify “You must have the Talisman’s effect active.”[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a delay in the tutorial text after acquiring the Hellfire Bottle from the desk in the Chapel’s study; the tutorial now appears promptly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue after interacting with one of the graves at the entrance: during NPC dialogues, the character’s stance could break, causing unintended jumps when advancing dialogue with a Gamepad.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where breakable objects (especially street lamps) blocked Deathsong Bullets when fired in front of them. These objects can now only be destroyed by melee attacks, ensuring bullets pass through cleanly.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Gravethorn Demo – Patch Notes (1.4.2)
notes.notes:
[h2]Mechanics & Controls[/h2][list][*][p][b]Gold Veins added[/b]
Large and small gold veins can now be found throughout the regions. Attacking these veins yields gold, creating an additional source of income.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Jump & Gravity Adjustments[/b]
Jump force and gravity have been rebalanced. Jumps feel smoother, and falling transitions more naturally.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]UI, UX & Accessibility[/h2][list][*][p][b]Shrine Menu — Quick Travel to Chapel[/b][/p][p]A dedicated [b]“Travel to The Chapel”[/b] button has been added below the Travel button in the Shrine menu. Once you’ve unlocked Travel, this makes reaching the Chapel faster without searching for it in the destination list.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Quick Item Menu Tutorial[/b][/p][p]A tutorial prompt for the Quick Item Menu has been added to the later sections of Ravenbell.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Audio & Visual Feedback[/h2][list][*][p][b]Dynamic Chapel Music[/b]
The Chapel now plays different background tracks depending on how many Memories the Inquisitor currently holds.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]UI & Upgrade Sound Effects[/b][/p][list][*][p]New sound effect when acquiring an item.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated sound effect when performing an upgrade.[/p][/*][*][p]Several missing sound effects have been implemented.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Gold Collection Visuals[/b]
Gold obtained from enemies, veins, or consumables now briefly hovers before flying toward the character, simulating the feeling of physically collecting coins.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Door Transition Effects[/b]
Walking through doors now includes a new step animation/sound effect, making transitions feel more grounded.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug introduced by Input Queue: if the player tried to attack after dying, the death animation was skipped and the character stood idle instead.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where holding the Interaction Button could bring up the Quick Item Menu in contexts where it shouldn’t appear.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where jumping out of a dodge caused restricted movement for a short time.[/p][/*][*][p]When the Inventory or Map interface was opened, background sound effects kept playing; this has been fixed.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Gravethorn Demo – Patch Notes (1.4)
notes.notes:
[p][i]Greetings! As I continue developing Gravethorn’s full version, a significant gap has formed between it and the demo. Therefore, this update brings improvements to the demo based on community feedback and ongoing work.[/i][/p][h3][/h3][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Mechanics & Controls[/h2][list][*][p][b]Final Verse System added[/b] When the player has no Deathsong Bullets remaining, a new system activates after a short delay (approx. 6–8 seconds). A single bullet is granted and can be fired as usual. A sound cue and a visual effect (similar to a charged Sorrowflame slot) indicate readiness. Final Verse is indicated by a circular slot under the bullet counter (top-left of the screen).[/p][/*][/list][p][i]This came straight from feedback. Final Verse is meant to offer a glimmer of hope, a last line of defense. In the full version, I plan to make this system synergize with Trinkets, Forbidden Arts, and Sigils for some wild builds. Also thinking about refunding bullets spent during failed attempts... but that’s a full release thing.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Quick Item Wheel for Consumables[/b]
You can now assign up to 4 consumables to a quick-use menu via the Inventory screen ("Assign Quick Item"). During gameplay, hold the Interaction key and use directional input to quickly use an assigned consumable.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Breakable Environmental Props[/b] Candles, lamps, poles, and some other decorations can now be destroyed by attacks.[/p][/*][/list][p][i]I saw players attacking props instinctively, only to be disappointed by the lack of interaction. This is my way of saying: "Yeah, that instinct was right."[/i][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Collectibles & World-Building[/h2][list][*][p][b]Strays of the Chapel (Collectible System)[/b] Cats once cared by Saint Nivareth and sheltered in the Night Lament Chapel have been added as hidden collectibles. Rescuing them rewards the player and brings them back to the chapel. Finding all strays unlocks a bonus reward (in the full game).[/p][/*][/list][p][i]These furry survivors bring warmth to the otherwise grim world. Sister loves them. So do I.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Trophy Display in the Chapel [/b]Bosses you’ve defeated now leave behind a memento item, which is placed on display inside the Chapel.[/p][/*][/list][p][i]This one’s simple, but satisfying. Seeing the fruits of your struggle decorate the walls of the Chapel adds a subtle sense of permanence, a record of what you’ve survived.[/i]
[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Lore & Dialogue[/h2][list][*][p][b]Talk to the Dead System added[/b] You can now use the [i]Deathspeaker’s Talisman[/i] (Consumable Item) to speak with specific corpses. Dialogue options like “Who are you?”, “How did you die?”, and “What do you know?” reveal useful info, keys to progression, or hidden quests.[/p][/*][/list][p][i]This was missing from the demo, even though it’s core to the full game’s narrative structure. Now you can try it right before the first boss.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Exile of the Broken Moon — Cutscene & Voice Lines[/b] When you first meet the Exile (Traveling for the first time), he now speaks. If certain quests are completed, a short travel cutscene plays.[/p][/*][/list][p][i]He used to be just a silent travel function. Now he's a character. Small change, big soul.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Added 2 new questlines.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Localization improvements for item descriptions and tutorial messages.[/b][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Forbidden Arts[/h2][list][*][p][b]Ascendant Arts (Locked Passive Perks added)[/b] Forbidden Arts now include a passive trait slot called “Ascendant Art,” displayed in the description. These passives unlock later in the full game. Some are unique to the specific skill, others are global boosts/traits.[/p][/*][/list][p][i]This is groundwork. You can’t access them yet, but I wanted to hint at the depth that’s coming.[/i][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]UI & UX[/h2][list][*][p][b]New Damage Screen Effect[/b] A short, impactful red flash now appears when the player takes damage. It's less intrusive than the low-health overlay but helps with moment-to-moment clarity.[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Recieved damage wasn’t reading clearly enough. This helps reinforce the feedback loop without overwhelming the screen.[/i][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Combat & Visuals[/h2][list][*][p][b]Execution Moves updated for Murkway and beyond[/b] Enemies encountered after the Murkway region now have new execution effects. Instead of traditional physical takedowns, magical executions have been added to maintain impact while reducing animation complexity.[/p][/*][/list][p][u][i]I’m solo-developing Gravethorn.[/i][/u][i] That means there’s no dedicated pixel artist working with me. For early-game enemies, I managed to edit existing assets to create unique executions... but the sheer number of enemy types later on makes it nearly impossible to animate them all myself. So I designed magical-style executions instead (Since Inquisitor is able to possess Forbidden Arts), they're stylized, hit hard, and keep the rhythm flowing.[/i][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Added new enemy placements to the Ravenbell region.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Item Adjustments[/h2][list][*][p][b]Strength Elixir[/b]: [strike]30s / +15% ATK[/strike] → 60s / +20% ATK[/p][/*][*][p][b]Robustness Elixir[/b]: [strike]30s / +5% DEF[/strike] → 60s / +20% DEF[/p][/*][*][p][b]Resistance Elixir[/b]: [strike]30s / +10% Status Resist[/strike] → 60s / +50% Status Resist[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sigil of Wailing Thorn[/b]: [strike]+30% ATK / x2 Damage Taken[/strike] → +25% ATK / x1.5 Damage Taken[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cold Embrace (Trinket)[/b]: [strike]Attacking a staggered enemy with Deathsong ends stagger but applies Frostburn.[/strike] → Attacks deal significantly increased damage to enemies already affected by Frostburn.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where crouching while attacking (or any action) would register as crouched, but not trigger the crouch animation.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a map note not clearing correctly in Murkway.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed fast travel unlocking incorrectly after acquiring the Thief’s Bag.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed unintended healing when pressing Confirm near NPCs after interacting with a Broken Shrine.[/p][/*][*][p](Hotfix 22.07.25) When fired with Deathsong, the bug where breakable props blocked the bullet from reaching the enemy has been fixed.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Gravethorn Demo – Patch Notes (1.35)
notes.notes: [h3]Mechanics & Controls[/h3][list][*][p]Wall jump mechanics reworked. You no longer need to hold directional keys to stay on walls — the character automatically clings when facing the wall and will slowly slide down. Pressing left/right won’t drop you, so you can pick your jump direction safely. Press down to cancel cling.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now jump during a dodge animation to cancel it. Previously, jump was disabled until the dodge animation (and some extra time) finished.[/p][/*][*][p]Input queuing added for attacks, dodges, ranged attacks, and jumps. If your input happens while the character is in action, the system checks briefly and executes it as soon as possible.[/p][/*][*][p]Jump queuing works even before landing — pressing jump slightly early will now trigger the jump after you hit the ground.[/p][/*][/list][h3]UI, UX & Accessibility[/h3][list][*][p]Camera shake significantly reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]Hit Flash whiteness reduced slightly. Both can be turned off entirely from [b]Accessibility Settings[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Inventory UI overhauled. Active [i]Trinkets, Forbidden Arts, Sigils, Character Status, Goals,[/i] and [i]Sufferings[/i] are now combined in a single screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Game Settings moved to the Inventory screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Starting Trinket slots increased to [u]2[/u], but the max Trinket slots are now capped at [u]4[/u] (so [i]you can upgrade twice, throughout the game[/i]).[/p][/*][/list][h3]Audio & Visual Feedback[/h3][list][*][p]Dynamic background music added based on the current region. Music playback frequency adjusted to prevent long silences.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Camera Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Camera now helps more clearly when descending to lower platforms.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the camera would stop tracking the player. Let me know if any edge cases persist.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Combat Balance[/h3][p][b]Bosses:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Mad Beast[/i]: Slight damage reduction, [b]significant[/b] HP reduction. Fixed bug where it floated too high.[/p][/*][*][p][i]Forgotten Sentinel[/i], [i]Cursed Deadborn[/i], [i]Laél[/i]: HP slightly reduced. [/p][/*][*][p]Laél’s phase-transition heal effect nerfed.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Enemies:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Skeletons[/i], [i]Skeleton Slimes[/i], [i]Burning Skulls[/i]: HP reduced. [/p][/*][*][p]Burning Skulls now deal contact damage.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]General:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fast Travel cost significantly reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy & boss gold rewards rebalanced.[/p][/*][*][p]Confessing to the Sister now costs less gold.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed bug where stored [i]Hellfire Bottles[/i] and [i]Deathsong Bullets[/i] could go into negative values.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed HTML errors (, ) in item descriptions for some localizations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a progression skip after defeating [i]Forgotten Sentinel[/i] that let players bypass the [i]Silver Wolf[/i] and advance through [i]Dreadmoore, and... fall into the void[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed respawn issues when dying far from the last Shrine.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed rare issue where some enemies or bosses would deal double hits.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]During Steam Next Fest, [i]Gravethorn[/i] reached far more players than I expected, and I received an incredible amount of feedback.[/p][p]Huge thanks to the [b]Steam Team[/b] for making this possible, and to [b]everyone[/b] who took the time to play the demo and share their thoughts.[/p]

notes.title: Gravethorn Demo – New Features & Bug Fixes (1.29c)
notes.notes:
[h3]New Features & Adjustments:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Inquisitor now automatically notes important locations and NPCs on the map. When a note is added, a notification appears at the bottom left of the screen. You can open the map to track your progress and remind yourself where to go next.

[*] Shrine areas on the map now display their names. This helps you decide where to travel before using the fast travel feature.

[*] The map UI has been scaled down by 25%, making it more compact and easier to navigate.

[*] "Unskippable Cutscenes" are now skippable (excluding The Intro). Hold Enter (or A on gamepad) to skip predefined scenes. This addresses players who dislike watching long cutscenes repeatedly or want to speed through them.

[*] To prevent missing or forgetting upgrades at Shrines, an alert text now appears above the statue when an upgrade is available. Similarly, in the upgrade (offerings) screen, a ! icon appears above the buttons for available upgrades.

[*] Some players had trouble distinguishing or noticing climbable platforms. Now, a subtle indicator appears when you are on or below these platforms to aid visibility.

[*] Completing a specific NPC’s quest now rewards the player with an item. (Which one? You’ll have to find out!)

[*] Ravenbell's visuals have been revamped and expanded. As the area with the heaviest corruption, environmental distortions and the unsettling presence of the Roots are now clearly visible.

[*] Crimson Lament's (Trinket) location in Ravenbell has been changed. Since players hadn't unlocked the Sorrowflame ability yet, giving them this item caused confusion. The trinket has been relocated, replaced by a "Small Coin Purse."

[*] Some players missed or misunderstood the “Repair the Workshop” quest. To clarify, an additional “Goal” has been added and can be tracked in the status window. Map notes also assist with this.

[*] Received feedback that tutorial texts were too long and difficult to read. Texts have been shortened and simplified accordingly. Localization updates for languages other than English and Turkish are ongoing and will be added soon.

[*] New sound effects have been added for The Murkway region.

[*] Burning Skull enemy’s HP has been reduced.

[*] Crimson Covenant (Forbidden Art) now deals more damage and attacks slightly faster.

[*] Sanguine Writ (Trinket) now grants more HP, and its condition has been clarified in the description.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Players could attack enemies above them by jumping under platforms, even with ground in between.

[*] In Ravenbell’s entrance, moving in the opposite direction while in the passageway caused the character to snap outside awkwardly.

[*] Wraithstone didn’t function correctly in The Murkway.

[*] Soulbound Root wasn't working properly.

[*] If the Forgotten Sentinel died during its aerial (4th attack) phase, the corpse would sometimes float in mid-air.

[*] Zombie enemies wouldn’t trigger execution when stunned with Deathsong.

[*] Zombie enemies would cause vibration or screen shake even if those settings were disabled.

[*] In rare cases, Bullet or Hellfire Bottle would be given to the player after resting or reviving, even if they weren't in the storage.

[*] Minor translation adjustments.
[/list]

[h3]Known Issues:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Some players are experiencing excessively wide camera angles, causing parts of some assets to be visible when they shouldn't.

[*] Loading a saved game can rarely cause the game to freeze.

[*] Wall-jumping rarely fail mid-jump.

[*] Execution animations can sometimes desync or misalign with enemy positions.

[*] Some enemies are launched too far if hit during a dash or while under a Forbidden Art effect.

[*] Burning Skull enemies occasionally don’t move at all.

[*] When opening the map, it doesn't center on the player's current location.

[*] In some languages, text appears too large, too small, or misaligned on the screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Gravethorn Demo – Minor Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Below are some minor fixes and adjustments related to the demo:

[list]
[*] The maximum HP of the Mad Beast (Prologue/Tutorial boss) has been slightly reduced.
[*] Fixed an issue where rapidly pressing Enter (or A on gamepad) during dialogue could cause the choice screen to not appear. Advancing through dialogues is now much snappier. A slight input delay has also been added to choice prompts to prevent accidental selections.
[*] Fixed an issue where the icon for The Iron Maw shrine in The Murkway was visible on the map even though it hadn’t been activated yet.
[*] Text prompts such as "Interaction" or "Pick Up" would remain on screen when opening the settings menu—this has been resolved.
[*] Fixed a bug where firing upwards and then walking wouldn’t properly transition to the walking animation.
[*] The Dreadmoore region was not updating correctly on the map—this has been fixed.
[*] After dying and respawning at a shrine, the player’s location would not update on the map—this has been corrected.
[*] In the shrine Travel menu, switching from the Dreadmoore tab to The Murkway would generate duplicate some buttons—this has been addressed.
[*] Fast traveling from The Murkway to Mourning Hollow would incorrectly place the player outside the chapel—this issue has been fixed.
[*] Two items (Rusty Key and Whispers) had incorrect names in the inventory—these have been corrected.
[*] The description of Key of the Cage mistakenly referred to a “little girl” instead of “young girl” due to a translation error—this has been fixed.
[*] Some tutorial triggers were placed too closely together, causing tutorial texts to instantly disappear if the player moved or dodged too quickly.
[/list]

notes.title: Gravethorn Demo Now Available!
notes.notes:
[h3]You can now download and play the demo version of Gravethorn from the store page![/h3]

While the game is still in active development, this demo will give you a taste of the core gameplay, exploration, and storytelling elements. Please note that this build does [b]not[/b] represent the final version of the game. Your feedback and suggestions after playing the demo will be incredibly valuable in shaping the final experience.

The demo includes two difficulty modes, both of which will also be available in the full release:
[list]
[*] [b]Standard[/b] – the default and recommended challenge.
[*] [b]Story[/b] – a more accessible option, offering reduced incoming damage, increased player damage, an extra Healt Potion, higher Bullet and Throwable capacity, and more Mana gained per hit.
[/list]

Please be aware that in languages other than English and Turkish, some localization issues may be present, such as inconsistent names, awkward phrasing, or incorrect translations. I apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

If you experience issues while customizing your key bindings (such as keys not assigning correctly or remaining unbound), try pressing the "Revert to Default" button and reconfiguring from scratch. If problems persist, feel free to reach out to me via email.

You can share your thoughts and suggestions by posting in the Feedback thread on the game's forum, or by contacting me directly at:

volviirdev@gmail.com

Thank you for your interest—and happy hunting!

– Volviir
